nodes.label: desktop memory - the v3 native artefact subsystem

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. The artefact, the system under test, lives in v3/artefact/, rebuilt natively from raw, with herb-eval as a contrast baseline only and never queried live. The deterministic spine is built and tested, 36 tests via python -m pytest artefact/tests from v3/: scan.py the file catalog, probe.py shape recovery, chunk.py coherence-episode chunking, derive_corpus.py the oracle strip, resolver_prototype.py hash-verified reference resolution, and keys/Salesforce__HERB.yaml the mapping key. The graph and retrieval are BUILT and run as pass 1, 06-28, from a parallel session, but the precision is unacceptable per the user's own verdict: embed_tags.py embeds the tag corpus at 22,235 tag instances over 5,377 chunks and 13,776 unique phrases; artefact/index.py is an in-memory PreparedIndex; artefact/graph_store.py ingests into a fresh herb-v3 DB, blocked on a local Neo4j server and NEO4J_PASSWORD, with the in-memory index as the real query path; artefact/prepass.py is a deterministic exact-literal pre-pass; artefact/interpreter.py is a one-shot NIM flagger on meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct; and pipelines/artefact.py is the combinator - interpret, embed facet phrases, mean-center, cosine against the tag matrix, max-pool one pooled facet set, flat accumulate per chunk, a +1.0 additive product-literal boost, then top-k - where the flat-accumulate scoring is the precision problem. The gold-100 k=10 retrieval-only result was context_recall_id 0.199 against lucene 0.035 and vector 0.045, but context_precision_id 0.068 against 0.102 and 0.148, worse than both, with the user's verdict that 'more effective but way fucking worse' is not a good reference and the numbers must not be cited as validating the design. Pass 2 is designed, not built. CANON_AUDIT.md 6.7 flags the 'never queried live' claim as STALE against an entire arm that queries it live
